title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 24: Joash repairs the temple, turns away after Jehoiada's death, and is punished.

questions.text: How old was Joash when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: During whose days did Joash do what was right in Yahweh's eyes?
questions.explanation: Joash did what was right in Yahweh's eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

questions.text: Who, according to verse 7, had broken up God's house?
questions.explanation: The sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God's house and given its dedicated things to the Baals.

answers.text: The priests of Baal from Samaria

questions.text: What did the king command to be made and set outside at the gate of Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: The king commanded, and they made a chest and set it outside at the gate of Yahweh's house.

questions.text: Whom did they hire to restore Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: They hired masons and carpenters, and also those who worked iron and bronze, to repair Yahweh's house.

questions.text: How old was Jehoiada when he died?
questions.explanation: Jehoiada grew old and was full of days; he was one hundred thirty years old when he died.
They buried him in David's city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.

answers.text: In David's city among the kings
In the field of burial outside the city
In the court of Yahweh's house

questions.text: Who was stoned in the court of Yahweh's house at the commandment of the king?
questions.explanation: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; they conspired against him and stoned him in the court of Yahweh's house at the king's command.

questions.text: What did Zechariah say when he died?
questions.explanation: When he died, he said, "May Yahweh look at it, and repay it."

answers.text: "Into your hand I commit my spirit."
"May Yahweh look at it, and repay it."

questions.text: How large was the Syrian army that defeated Judah's very great army?
questions.explanation: The army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and Yahweh delivered a very great army into their hand.

answers.text: A great multitude with many chariots
An army equal in size to Judah's
